user.description: Choose the Shelly dimmer this profile controls. Add time slots afterwards.

error.not_shelly: This light does not belong to a Shelly device.

abort.already_configured: This light already has a profile.

user.title: Time slot
user.description: A time slot is active from its start time until the next time slot starts.

data_description.brightness: Brightness of this time slot (and end value of the ramp).
data_description.on_turn_on: Turn on directly at the brightness, or start a ramp.

data_description.curve: Quadratic and cubic start slower, which looks more even.
data_description.repeat: Ramp again on every turn-on, or only once per time slot.
data_description.resume_minutes: Turned on again within this time, the ramp is not restarted. 0 = always restart.
data_description.resume_mode: Continue the ramp from the last brightness, or stay at the last brightness.

slot_change.name: Start of this time slot while the light is on

data_description.mode: None: applies from the next turn-on. Hard: change immediately. Soft: fade to the new brightness.
